mode.title: Mode
mode.description: latest = the most recent value each country has actually published, with the change on the period before. history = every period in the window. dataset = any Eurostat dataset code with your own filters.

countries.title: Countries (optional)
countries.description: Two letter codes, e.g. DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, PL. Note Greece is EL and not GR. Empty returns every reporting country.

periods.title: Periods to look back
periods.description: How many periods to request. Countries publish on different schedules, so a small window is needed in latest mode to find each one's most recent figure.

includeAggregates.title: Include EU and euro area aggregates
includeAggregates.description: Off by default. The source publishes the EU and the euro area alongside the countries, so including them double counts any ranking or average you build.

datasetCode.title: Dataset code (dataset mode)
datasetCode.description: Any Eurostat dataset code, for example prc_hicp_manr or nrg_pc_202.

datasetParams.title: Dataset filters (dataset mode)
datasetParams.description: Dimension filters as a query string, e.g. coicop=CP00&unit=RCH_A. A value that does not exist returns an empty result rather than an error.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned across all indicators. Controls total cost.
